refusal.reason: The passages contain no information on Moderna's vaccine sales in fiscal 2008. Moderna did not record product sales until December 2020, and the provided filings only cover fiscal 2020 onward.
found: Moderna recognized $199.9 million of COVID-19 vaccine product sales for the year ended December 31, 2020.
Moderna achieved 2023 net product sales of $6.7 billion, including $6.1 billion of COVID-19 vaccine sales.
Moderna achieved 2024 net product sales of $3.1 billion.
